# teams_app_setup_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing AppSetupPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `additional_customization_apps` (String) Maps to the -AdditionalCustomizationApps parameter.
- `allow_side_loading` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowSideLoading parameter.
- `allow_user_pinning` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowUserPinning parameter.
- `app_preset_list` (String) Maps to the -AppPresetList parameter.
- `app_preset_meeting_list` (String) Maps to the -AppPresetMeetingList parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `pinned_app_bar_apps` (String) Maps to the -PinnedAppBarApps parameter.
- `pinned_calling_bar_apps` (String) Maps to the -PinnedCallingBarApps parameter.
- `pinned_message_bar_apps` (String) Maps to the -PinnedMessageBarApps parameter.
